verdict.rationale: Insomnia has a dedicated spec design view for building/iterating OpenAPI specs with live preview, linting, and code snippet generation, and supports exporting/importing OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 directly, including CLI linting via inso for CI workflows. This directly satisfies spec-first design and OpenAPI export. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration specifically of the spec-design workflow (community evidence is mostly about the REST client, not the design feature) and detail on export fidelity for complex specs.
